inward_actual_bands.scope: middle-png episode0 inward actual saved optical only; no nonlinear/error bound

corrected_actual_bands.scope: middle-png episode0 corrected actual saved optical only; no nonlinear/error bound

evaluation.boundary_metric: sampled bidirectional lower approximation; not a certified supremum

limitations: Saved-data consistency audit only; no new subject, forward, oracle, reference, QP, point, census, gradient, fitting, or test execution.
Gram identities and saved row-space components are verified, not solved.
Raw source and storage-eroded actual bands are descriptive; proposal margins do not enclose stale-J, mixed-brightness, area or nonlinear errors.
Zero training and conditional reserved residuals do not prove unique geometry or physical accuracy.
